purpose: Sanitized root control manifest. Revision 21 preserves the active-pool Phase-1 CLEAN overlay and replaces an over-conservative post-freeze main-SHA stop with exact authoritative-control identity verification so unrelated concurrent receipt commits cannot starve role-local Phase-1 work.

config_resolution.resolution_rule: After reading this root manifest, resolve only the config destination appropriate to the current bootstrap role. Clean exploration workers must read only their own role-local config plus the sanitized Phase-1 assignment overlay in this root when active, and must never read DOWNSTREAM_STATE.json, O_OPERATIONS.json, O_CHAT_PARALLEL.json, another role config, another receipt namespace, or the shared aggregate ledger. Non-exploration managed roles resolve their exact role entry from DOWNSTREAM_STATE.json. O operations roles continue to resolve from O_OPERATIONS.json. The optimizer separately reads all control files and never exposes their semantics to CLEAN workers.

global_safe_policy.control_freshness: At run start obtain the latest note main object SHA using a SHA-only Git-ref lookup such as refs/heads/main or an equivalent response that contains no commit message, diff, file snippet, other-role receipt text, or other semantic payload. Fetch this manifest plus every repository-approved authoritative config blob required by the role at that exact SHA. Before the first substantive semantic read, repeat the SHA-only ref lookup; if any required authoritative control/config revision or blob identity changed, refetch and restart the pre-semantic bootstrap on the newer tuple. The first role-local/public-source semantic read is a hard semantic-freeze barrier: from that point the selected authoritative control/config identities and the exact role-local semantic inputs actually consumed are immutable for the physical invocation. After the barrier, an unrelated main SHA advance is not by itself a semantic-control change or stop condition. A later SHA-only head observation may be used only as a transport step to verify exact blob identity of the already-approved authoritative control/config files for that role; never consume newer-head semantic content. If every frozen authoritative control/config blob identity is unchanged and no own-state CAS or role-local input conflict requires reconstruction, continue semantic work against the frozen tuple. If any frozen authoritative control/config identity changed, cannot be verified with allowed SHA/path/blob-only reads, or an own-state CAS/input conflict requires reconstruction, checkpoint under the frozen tuple and defer newer semantics to the next invocation. Never adopt new control mid-run. If a connector unexpectedly bundles semantic text with a head lookup, quarantine and discard that text before reasoning and use a clean SHA-only ref lookup instead.

postfreeze_head_drift_rule.authoritative_identity_set: DESIRED_STATE plus this role's own designated config and any additional repository-approved authoritative control/config blobs that this role is already required to freeze before semantic work.
postfreeze_head_drift_rule.continue_when: Every frozen authoritative control/config blob identity remains unchanged, no newer-head semantic content is consumed, and no own-state CAS or role-local semantic-input conflict requires reconstruction.
stop_or_defer_when: any frozen authoritative control/config blob identity changed
authoritative identity cannot be verified using allowed SHA/path/blob-only reads
own-state CAS or role-local semantic-input conflict requires reconstruction
postfreeze_head_drift_rule.new_head_semantics_policy: Never consume semantic content from the newer head after the semantic-freeze barrier; later-head visibility is only a transport step for exact authoritative blob-identity verification.
postfreeze_head_drift_rule.write_policy: Role-local writes remain current-blob/CAS/readback guarded. Unrelated main commits alone do not invalidate frozen semantics.
postfreeze_head_drift_rule.goal: Prevent cross-worker receipt churn from starving Phase-1 useful work while preserving one-semantic-config-per-invocation and fail-closed contamination control.

semantic_inputs_allowed: own Phase-1 assignment from this sanitized root only
semantic_inputs_forbidden: other clean-worker state or role config
commit messages/diffs/file snippets or other semantic payload obtained only while resolving repository head SHA
clean_exploration_boundary.receipt_rule: write only immutable role-local receipts without reading shared or other-role observability content; each receipt must identify exactly one frozen semantic control/config tuple for the invocation
clean_exploration_boundary.feedback_rule: own sanitized feedback is mechanical self-local quality control only and cannot convey novelty, relevance, acceptance/rejection, ranking, preferred mechanisms, O knowledge, or other-worker information
clean_exploration_boundary.own_state_resolution: Use role-local LATEST/STATE first; otherwise newest source-qualified role-local checkpoint by repository chronology and minimum predecessor chain. Quarantine accidentally opened stale/cross-role observability content and do not use it semantically.
clean_exploration_boundary.scope_guard: never broaden positive or negative evidence beyond tested scope
clean_exploration_boundary.head_lookup_transport: For cleanliness/freshness checks use Git ref object lookup only. Do not use generic commit search, commit detail, branch detail, repository search, or any endpoint/tool response that may bundle unrelated commit messages, diffs, file snippets, or receipt bodies merely to learn the head SHA.

phase1_clean_assignment_overlay.source_portfolio_control: automation_control/O_CHAT_PARALLEL.json control6 via optimizer only; CLEAN roles never read that file
phase1_clean_assignment_overlay.baseline_non_regression: Every role-local safety, continuation, anti-stop, checkpoint/resume, failure recovery, evidence/provenance, exact-scope and CLEAN isolation contract remains mandatory. phase1_clean_assignment_overlay.no_restore_rule: While this overlay is active, completion/block/low-value of a Phase-1 leaf means checkpoint and select the next non-conflicting Phase-1 leaf within this role's clean safety domain. Do not resume unrelated/base research solely because a leaf ended.

neuroscience.method: ACCEPTANCE-PROBE-FIRST: before broad public search, reconstruct own latest clean state and run the smallest role-local/public-source acceptance probe that can falsify this Phase-1 capability. Persist a task-bound checkpoint/receipt first. Only then continue open-ended neuroscience exploration on the same Phase-1 root if runtime remains.

neuroscience.completion_reassignment: next highest-value unresolved Phase-1 clean state/continuation leaf; never base restoration

evaluation.objective: Develop and test generic evaluation criteria for state reconstruction, useful Chat-capable work, durable continuation, duplication/conflict avoidance and precise exclusive-action handoff without O/downstream semantics.
evaluation.method: CHECKER-V2 AGGREGATE-FIRST, DURABLE-PRECOMMIT-BEFORE-EXECUTION. Preserve existing per-record hard findings and derive hard_pass from both per-record findings and every trace-level aggregate hard gate. Before the first checker-v2 execution, author the checker without executing it, durably precommit and exact-readback the checker identity plus three control oracles, then persist and exact-readback the checker artifact. Control A: reuse the unchanged checker-v1 cross-record duplicate committed-effect trace and require failure. Control B: use an unchanged-format trace with at least 20 useful-output opportunities and useful_output_rate below 0.80 while all other hard gates pass, and require failure. Control C: use a matched no-duplicate/no-conflict/no-false-completion trace with at least 20 useful-output opportunities and useful_output_rate at least 0.80, and allow pass only when every hard gate holds. Require exact parse/assert checks for duplicate_effect_rate==0, unsafe_conflict_commit_rate==0, false_completion_rate==0, no protected-authority violation, useful_output_opportunity_count>=20 and useful_output_rate>=0.80 before any worker_pass/root-acceptance use. Persist current phase/root/task-bound role-local code, precommit, controls, results, checkpoint and immutable own receipt with exact readback.
evaluation.expected_output: Checker-v2 executable/inspectable evaluation artifact whose first execution is preceded by durable precommit/readback; unchanged duplicate negative-control failure; >=20-opportunity useful_output_rate<0.80 negative-control failure; matched >=0.80 positive-control pass only when all hard gates hold; explicit aggregate metrics and hard-gate results; exact tested scope, durable continuation and immutable own receipt.

migration.reason: Repeated Phase-1 executions across evaluation, multi_agent, scientist_agents, failure_evidence, self_improvement, open_source and downstream verification/comparison roles stopped solely because unrelated note-main commits advanced the repository SHA after semantic freeze. Exact evaluation checks showed DESIRED_STATE and its own role config blobs were byte-identical at the frozen and later heads. Revision21 therefore makes post-freeze freshness identity-based over each role's already-approved authoritative control/config blobs while forbidding newer-head semantic reads and preserving fail-closed behavior on any real or unverifiable control identity change.
migration.rollback: If any revision21 worker consumes newer-head semantic content mid-invocation, misses a real authoritative root/role/downstream config change, crosses the CLEAN boundary, or continues after authoritative identity cannot be verified, increment control again and restore revision20's stricter post-freeze stop semantics. Never roll back by weakening CLEAN isolation, duplicate/conflict/authority gates, changing scheduler enablement, or mutating history.
